> **Source type:** Explicit user correction
> **Observed:** 2026-09-15T06:46:47Z
> **Do not edit this file. Edit the derived wiki page instead.**

Vik said the work felt like a waste of time, asked whether it was in a branch,
said existing Loci calls were enough to inspect graph behavior, and gave the
mantra: "build now -> dogfood -> cut and fix as needed".

Vik's direction is build now -> dogfood -> cut and fix as needed. Use existing ordinary Loci calls and real repository work to identify observed failures; exact net-efficiency measurement and speculative edge-case infrastructure are not prerequisites for using the implemented graph behavior. The custom complete-work runner/campaign is parked and must not resume by default. Current work is on master (57b91ee implementation,734d329 handoff), not an isolated branch; no branch move, code removal or Objective acceptance was requested.

Live git branch/log shows master at734d329 with57b91ee immediately before it.
The retained binding-v4 execution receipt says both native agents invoke Loci and
receive required relationship proof, one exact source-reference read succeeds,
and validated results retain an input-gate failure and delivery qualifications.
This supports practical use of the graph behavior; it does not establish exact
token savings, model reliance, or complete-work efficiency.

The primary accepts the scope correction: measurement machinery displaced useful
work, and the custom launcher had not been shown to run under this host's sandbox.
Prefer the smallest implementation/check needed for the actual work, then
dogfood and fix evidence-backed failures. Existing correctness requirements still
apply to included behavior; hypothetical edge cases alone do not justify new
required infrastructure. The next ordinary task supplies dogfood evidence.
The old benchmark plan/evidence stays as history, with no new experiment or code
cleanup started. No new Manifest task is created for merely adopting this rule.

References: /Users/brummerv/loci/.scratch/deterministic-graph-retrieval/binding-v4-execution.md;
live branch/log; the existing Manifest campaign card W1.8.4.4.10.2.3 now records
the user's parking direction ahead of its retained historical plan.
